## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:downloads`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant behavior tested in a browser, including the production build

For download changes, record single-file and ZIP checks, downloaded content, duplicate filenames, browser/device details, and embedded-host behavior where tested.

## Review notes

Mention user-visible limitations, risks, or follow-up work. Attach only non-sensitive screenshots or synthetic sample files.

- [ ] Documentation reflects any behavior changes
- [ ] No credentials, private input files, runtime logs, or generated build output included
